items.title: Police dismantle Kratos phishing platform, arrest developer
items.description: Authorities in Germany and the U.S. dismantled the central infrastructure of Kratos, a phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) platform with global reach, and its developer was arrested in Indonesia. [...]

items.title: FakeGit campaign uses 7,600 GitHub repos to push SmartLoader malware
items.description: A large-scale operation dubbed 'FakeGit' is pushing SmartLoader and StealC malware through 7,600 malicious GitHub repositories that accumulated more than 14 million downloads. [...]

items.title: Ransomware Is Accelerating, But It's Not Because of AI
items.description: Researchers pointed to fragmentation of the ransomware ecosystem, the emergence of new attackers, and expansion of attacks on less defended organizations.

items.title: Using LLMs to Find and Prioritize Vulnerabilities Is No Easy Task
items.description: The latest large language models have high false-positive rates and fail to take into account the context of scans, leading to more work for AppSec professionals.

items.title: Hackers Turn Fake Games Into Multi-Stage Infostealers That Steal Passwords and Crypto Wallets
items.description: Criminals are using fake game downloads to slip a sophisticated information stealer onto Windows computers. The campaign hides behind supposed games, mods, cracks, and other software, exploiting the trust and urgency around free or hard-to-find downloads. items.title: Qilin Ransomware Claims 1,358 Victims as Global Attacks Reach New Record
items.description: Qilin ransomware has grown from a fast-moving criminal operation into one of the most visible threats in the global extortion landscape. The group encrypts systems and steals data, then pressures victims with the risk of public leaks.
